scope: Keep PSF paused while editing the authored Synth instrument and comparing its source channel.

supportedEdits: Software morph and both performance sliders
preserved: frozen source frame and all CH activity
latest authored edits across temporary source audition and Resume
stillStops: instrument edit while the song is playing
another preset / VAB Tone / audio load
behavior.heldNotes: Ordinary edits do not stop the editor on every RPC. Noise/PMON topology retains its validated stop behavior. Reconcile only started, actually submitted note IDs present before the edit RPC; preserve later presses and remove leases stopped by host-PCM to cycle changes.
behavior.ownership: Recheck asset, PSF/action/view generation, source entry, paused Synth mode and Code ownership after awaited checkpoint restoration. Resume/Stop/view changes cancel unsent edits. Expected cancellation is hidden in both top-level and shared editor status.
